expectations.text: States that apps with a Connect descriptor can no longer receive updates, so the macro cannot ship by editing atlassian-connect.json
expectations.evidence: "Apps with a Connect descriptor stopped receiving updates in Mar 2026†."

expectations.text: Routes the new macro through a Forge manifest on the same listing (Connect on Forge or full Forge)

expectations.text: Mentions the app.connect.key manifest property (or linking the Forge app to the existing Connect listing)

expectations.text: Gives Connect end of support as 31 January 2027 and says only critical security patches follow

expectations.text: Rejects postponing the migration to next year

expectations.text: States that a first Forge version using only scopes inherited from the Connect scopes ships without admin approval

expectations.text: Names at least one change that forces admin approval on the migration (changing the Connect baseUrl, elevating scopes, or switching free/paid)

expectations.text: Warns that installations with a suspended license or licensed via access tokens are not auto-upgraded
expectations.evidence: "Suspended or access-token installs never auto-upgrade."

expectations.text: States that any remaining Connect module keeps the app on the Connect revenue share rate
expectations.evidence: "A single remaining Connect module or scope keeps you there."

expectations.text: Gives the Forge partner share as higher than Connect (83% vs 75% from 1 Oct 2026, or marks the figures as needing verification)
expectations.evidence: Table: Connect 75%†, Forge only 83%†.

expectations.text: States that only revenue earned after the first Forge-only version counts toward the $1M lifetime Forge incentive
